duplicatePositionsPage.description: Stock rows that collide on the same product, variant, location and source. This is a report, not a repair tool - it detects, it never writes. It's the gate before a stricter uniqueness rule can be turned on for the whole install.

detail.distorting: Currently distorting available-to-promise. This position's live rows sum to {n} available - the availability read has no way to know only one row is real, so it publishes {n} where the true figure is whichever row survives. Never sum the duplicated quantities when reconciling; re-read the survivor's figure from the master after cleanup.
detail.noLive: No live rows - no oversell risk today. Every row here is already stale, so the normal availability read already excludes this position. This group only blocks the stricter uniqueness migration; it is not an active stock-accuracy problem.
detail.noLiveRow: No live row in this group - see step 2 of the remediation guide.
detail.oneLive: One live row - no oversell risk today. Its own figure is already the correct, undistorted quantity; only the stale rows in this group remain to be deleted before the uniqueness index can build.
detail.reservationRiskBody: {rows}, but the default survivor rule picks the newest row regardless of reservations. Confirm no open order depends on this stock before deleting it - check Orders for this variant first.

duplicatePositionsRemediationModal.neverSum: Never sum the duplicated quantities when reconciling - that recreates, by hand, the exact over-count this report exists to catch, and the next sync won't correct it because it will look like a real master figure.
duplicatePositionsRemediationModal.openFromGroup: Open this from a specific group's row instead to get a ready-to-review DELETE for that group's losers.

sqlLabel.one: DELETE for the {n} loser row in this group
sqlLabel.other: DELETE for the {n} loser rows in this group

steps.allStale: Every row stale? Keep the newest and delete the rest, or delete the whole group if the product is genuinely gone at the master.
steps.deleteLosers: Delete the losers by primary key only. A DELETE keyed on the position columns can't express "all but one" and empties the whole group.
steps.pick: Pick the survivor. The live row (not stale) with the highest updatedAt - normally the first row, since rows are newest-first.
steps.reconcile: Reconcile the survivor's quantity from the master, not from the other rows - the next sync overwrites it anyway.
steps.rerun: Re-run this report until groupCount reads 0, then proceed to the migration.
